vintage_requirement.origin_training: Only observations with acquisition/release time at or before each forecast origin; reconstructed from Issue 9 snapshots, never retrofitted
vintage_requirement.candidate_truth: Scored from independently archived truth vintage at evaluation cutoff
vintage_requirement.cross_source: Eurostat only audit comparator, not training replacement

development.data_scaling: No full-sample transformation; MASE denominator uses training-only seasonal differences

metrics.MASE: absolute forecast error divided by training-only mean absolute seasonal difference; null when denominator zero
metrics.sMAPE: 200×|actual−forecast|/(|actual|+|forecast|); null for both zero; interpretation caveats
metrics.coverage: empirical interval coverage only for independently precalibrated bounds; missing otherwise
metrics.stability: by horizon, per origin and across alternative historical evaluation windows

preconditions: authenticated official Destatis provenance and source vintage fidelity confirmed
24 final holdout months reserved and unopened until candidate frozen
at least 12 comparable holdout forecast errors per horizon
model compared with seasonal naive on exact common origin/target pairs
numerical: candidate MAE <=95% seasonal-naive MAE at each horizon
minimum 20 independent interval observations per horizon for empirical coverage review
nominal 90% interval empirical coverage must lie between 80% and 98% at each horizon
governance: independent final assessment and source-unit consistency
review sample size and dependency of overlapping horizons
no claim of statistical significance without adequate uncertainty analysis
proposed_release_gate.fallback: benchmark-only with transparent failure reasons; no calibrated model forecast presented

prior_results: No actual German statistical backtests or empirical benchmark superiority claimed
creator_note: Thresholds are preliminary prespecified business quality gates, not observed facts; freeze before using a genuine final holdout.
